entities.summary: Klang Valley is an urban agglomeration in Malaysia centred on the federal territories of Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya, along with their surrounding cities and towns in the state of Selangor. The Greater Kuala Lumpur metropolitan area is located within the Klang Valley.
